name: Hobgoblin Slayer
body:
The hatred of hobgoblins courses through your veins.

Benefit: Whenever you’re within 60 feet of an enemy hobgoblin, you gain a +1 trait bonus on all weapon damage rolls.

Pathfinder Player Companion: Goblins of Golarion. © 2011, Paizo Publishing, LLC; Author: James Jacobs, Hal Maclean, and Richard Pett.
